sentences.text: The Buff-tailed Bumblebee is an insect in the order Hymenoptera.
In Mainz-Bingen, 728 reports were recorded over ten years, with the main time running from February to September.
It has been recorded eating Garden cosmos, Spotted Dead-nettle, Apple, and Phacelia.
Flower visits have been recorded at Greater Knapweed, Creeping Thistle, White Clover, and Heather, among others.
